component.name: Sele
component.summary: A focused desktop workspace for AI coding agents

description.p: Sele is a desktop AI harness for working with Codex and GitHub Copilot across local projects. It brings conversations, project context, code changes, file editing, and terminal sessions together in one focused workspace.
Review changes as you work, move between projects and conversations, and keep the tools needed for agent-assisted development close at hand.
The Flatpak uses host command execution so that Codex, Git, shells, and developer tools installed on the computer remain available to Sele.

screenshot.caption: Work with an AI coding agent alongside project files and code changes

description.p: Added interactive Copilot questions and persistent chat titles, project-scoped settings and font controls, branch deletion workflows, and refreshed chat, action, and terminal interfaces.
Added container source support and zoom controls, improved chat switching performance, refined control surfaces, and fixed recursive restart handling.
Added GitHub Copilot support, improved host path resolution, and refreshed application metadata.
Improved controls, settings, host command handling, and cross-platform packaging.
